description: This file defines utility functions for formatting and styling output for command-line interfaces, such as colorizing text, padding, and formatting key-value pairs and tags. It also exports a masking utility and determines whether the output should be decorated with rich formatting.

methods.name: isRich
methods.description: Determines if the output should include rich formatting (colors, styles) based on terminal capabilities and options.

methods.name: pad
methods.description: Pads a string to a specified length using the end padding.

methods.name: formatKey
methods.description: Colorizes a key string based on the theme and formatting context.

methods.name: formatValue
methods.description: Colorizes a value string based on the theme and formatting context.

methods.name: formatKeyValue
methods.description: Formats and colorizes a key and value pair, separated by '='.

methods.name: formatSeparator
methods.description: Returns a separator string styled with the theme.

methods.name: formatTag
methods.description: Styles a tag string based on its value and the rich formatting flag.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Shortens a string to a maximum length, adding ellipsis if truncated.

ctags.name: formatKey
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatKey = (key: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.warn, key);$/

ctags.name: formatValue
ctags.pattern: /^export const formatValue = (value: string, rich: boolean) => colorize(rich, theme.info, value);$/

ctags.name: isRich
ctags.pattern: /^export const isRich = (opts?: { json?: boolean; plain?: boolean }) =>$/

ctags.name: pad
ctags.pattern: /^export const pad = (value: string, size: number) => value.padEnd(size);$/
